requirement: An enum declaration defines its type's name, accessibility, underlying type and members.
An enum declaration uses optional attributes and modifiers, enum and its name, an optional base, a body and an optional terminating semicolon.
An enum may specify its underlying type with a colon and an integral_type keyword.
An enum may specify its underlying type with a colon and an integral_type_name.
An integral_type_name uses the type_name grammar.

requirement: An enum's integral_type_name must resolve to an integral type other than char.
An enum body encloses an optional enum member list in braces.
A nonempty enum body may include a comma after its last member.

requirement: Every enum has a corresponding integral underlying type.
The enum's underlying type must represent every declared enumerator value.
An enum_base specifies the enum's underlying type explicitly.

requirement: An enum with no explicit underlying type has int as its underlying type.
An enum cannot declare its own type-parameter list.

requirement: An enum nested inside a generic class is itself generic.

quote_json: "generic struct declaration is a generic enum declaration"
requirement: An enum nested inside a generic struct is itself generic.

quote_json: "type arguments for the containing type shall be supplied"
requirement: Constructing a nested enum requires the containing generic type's arguments.

quote_json: "optionally include a sequence of enum modifiers"
requirement: An enum declaration may contain a sequence of enum modifiers.
The enum_modifier grammar admits new in a permitted declaration context.
The enum_modifier grammar admits public in a permitted declaration context.
The enum_modifier grammar admits protected in a permitted declaration context.
The enum_modifier grammar admits internal in a permitted declaration context.
The enum_modifier grammar admits private in a permitted declaration context.
An enum declaration cannot repeat a modifier.

quote_json: "same meaning as those of a class declaration"
requirement: Enum declaration modifiers have the corresponding class-declaration meanings.

requirement: An enum declaration cannot include abstract.
An enum declaration cannot include sealed.
An enum declaration cannot include static.
An enum type is never abstract.
No type may derive from an enum type.

quote_json: "No two enum members can have the same name"
requirement: An enum cannot declare two members with the same name.
A nonempty enum member list consists of member declarations separated by commas.
An enum member uses optional attributes, an identifier and an optional equals sign followed by a constant expression.
Each enum member has an associated constant value.

quote_json: "type of this value is the underlying type"
requirement: An enum member's associated constant value has its containing enum's underlying type.
Different enum members may have the same associated value.

quote_json: "implicitly converted to the underlying type of the enum"
requirement: An initialized enum member's associated value is its constant initializer implicitly converted to the underlying type.
The first enum member has associated value zero when it has no initializer.

quote_json: "increasing the associated value of the textually preceding enum member by one"
requirement: An uninitialized enum member after the first has the preceding member's associated value plus one.
An implicit enum value increment cannot exceed the underlying type's representable range.

quote_json: "directly or indirectly, use the value of its own associated enum member"
requirement: An enum member's associated value cannot depend on itself directly or indirectly.
An enum initializer may refer to another member's value at any textual position if the value dependency is acyclic.

quote_json: "treated as having the type of their underlying type"
requirement: References to enum members within enum member initializers are treated as values of the underlying type.

quote_json: "scope of an enum member is the body of its containing enum type"
requirement: An enum member's scope is its containing enum body, analogously to a class field.
An enum member may be referenced by its simple name within its scope.

quote_json: "shall be qualified with the name of its enum type"
requirement: Code outside an enum member's scope must qualify its name with the enum type's name.
notes: The paragraph's blanket wording is recorded; interactions with imported static members are owned elsewhere and remain a question.

requirement: Enum members have no individually declared accessibility.

quote_json: "accessible if its containing enum type is accessible"
requirement: An enum member is accessible wherever its containing enum type is accessible.
